name: Saint Antony of Padua, Stretford and Trafford Park

boundary.description: From the confluence of Manchester Ship Canal and Bridgewater Canal (Stretford and Leigh Branch), SE along the Bridgewater Canal to and S along Old Trafford Road, S along Wharfside Way, White City Way and by a beeline to and SW along the railway. Then S by Great Stone Road and Kings Road to its junction with Marston Road and by a beeline to and SW along Trafford – Manchester District boundary to River Mersey. W along the River Mersey to the point opposite Meadow Road and by a beeline to and N along Lime Tree Close, Stretford Road, Ciss Lane, St Clements Fold (both sides in Our lady and English Martyrs parish). Continuing N along Westbourne Park, Winchester Road, Furness Road, Canterbury Road, Rochester Road, Lostock Road, Romley Road and by a beeline to Kingsway Park, Skye Road (after its junction with Iona Way both sides in Our Lady and English Martyrs parish), then E along Shetland Way and by a beeline to M60 Motorway. W along the Motorway to Manchester Ship Canal and E along the Canal to its confluence with Bridgewater Canal.

internalBoundaries.name: Former boundary between St Hugh of Lincoln and St Ann
internalBoundaries.description: From the point where Bridgewater Canal Stretford and Leigh branch crosses Park Road, along Park Road to, and W along the railway, then S along Barton Road, Manor Road, Urmston Lane, Anchorage Road and by a straight line S to River Mersey.

internalBoundaries.name: Former boundary between St Hugh of Lincoln and St Anthony
internalBoundaries.description: From the point where Bridgewater Canal Stretford and Leigh Branch crosses park Road, NW along that canal to its confluence with Manchester Ship Canal.

internalBoundaries.name: Former boundary between St Anthony and St Ann
internalBoundaries.description: From the point wherer Bridgewater Canal Towpath crosses Old Trafford Road, S along Bridgewater Canal Towpath to its confluence with Bridgewater Canal Stretford and Leigh Branch and along that canal to the point where it crosses Park Road.
